title: the salsa storm strikes on the half bar
story: Aguanile at 129 BPM: a mambo of loud horn and percussion hits (onsets up to 19.7) builds over eight bars, a tighter salsa groove starts at 2561 (bright hits on the 16ths before beats 3 and 4, a dark tone on the & of 4), the band lands at 2740 and the full tumbao runs from 2799 with the accent on 4 and its pickup. The tropical-sunset storm teaches its clock first, one strike per bar on the downbeat, and every big mambo hit throws a kaleidoscope crown with a shake and a red hue step while reach and the electrode glow climb; at 2561 the clock halves to strikes on 1 and 3 with the electrode jumping sides, slaps burst fire and open tones punch the zoom; the drop strikes on every beat inside a six-fold crown with contrast opened, and the groove after it keeps the half-bar strikes, fire on every 4, a hue sway on each pickup and the crown returning every two bars.
